literal: Having become subtle and extensive knowledge what will become, towards anyone having coveted senseless things if does?
translation: What is the use of subtle and extensive knowledge, if one covets the property of others and commits senseless deeds?
modern: ஒருவன் பிறர் பொருளுக்கு ஆசைப்பட்டு யாரிடத்தும் அறிவற்ற செயல்களைச் செய்வானானால், அவனது நுட்பமானதும் விரிவானதுமான அறிவால் என்ன பயன்?
explanation: The couplet questions the value of deep and wide-ranging knowledge if a person still falls prey to greed. The word அஃகி means becoming subtle or sharp, while அகன்ற means wide or extensive, together describing a highly refined intellect. Yet, என்னாம் asks what use this intellect is, if the person covets what belongs to others and commits வெறிய or senseless, foolish deeds. True knowledge should naturally prevent such ignorant behavior.
